messages:
svc_incident_bot: ALERT: control-plane-deps error spike detected — elevated 5xx from auth/org-lookup/billing (region: us-east-1). P50 latency ↑, 500s > 2% threshold. Pager sent to @maria and @ops_oncall :rotating_light:

maria: got it, joining. seeing customer-facing 502/504 on API gateway dashboards. spinning up thread. tagging infra and eng-runtime. @ops_oncall can you confirm paging?

ops_oncall: onpager here — I can access staging metrics, dashboards show auth upstream errors 502/503, org-lookup timeouts 10s+. traffic surge? no recent deploys in last 30m according to deploy-bot.

tom: I rolled a small config tweak to controlplane routing 18m ago (rate window change). rolling that back now as a quick guardrail unless someone objects.

leo: confirming logs from auth-proxy: repeated 5xx with "upstream connect error or disconnect" and many grpc status=14. org-lookup shows high connection errors to config-service. looks like a dependency fanout.

anita: billing team: traffic to billing is normal, but service reports increased queueing and timeouts when controlplane calls for entitlements. may be cascading from auth failures.

jay: quick idea — enable the cached-org-lookup fallback for 30m and reduce controlplane fanout concurrency. That should lower downstream pressure while we triage.

maria: agreed. @tom please rollback that routing change and @ops_oncall please flip cached-org-lookup=true. also add a short-circuit for billing calls to return cached entitlements when upstream times out.

ops_oncall: running commands now —
```bash
# rollback routing config
redctl config set controlplane.routing.mode previous
# enable cached org lookup
redctl feature-flag set cached-org-lookup true --ttl 300
```
ops_oncall: commands applied, propagation in progress.

svc_incident_bot: NOTE: rollback initiated by tom at 2591237400. feature flag change by ops_oncall at 2591237420.

rick: hitting the gateway directly for a few repro checks:
```
$ curl -I https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/models
HTTP/2 502
x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1204
server: envoy
```
rick: still seeing 502s intermittently but spike has dropped from ~8% -> ~1.8% in last 3m.

leo: telemetry shows decreased calls to config-service by 45% after feature flip. auth error rate trending down. KV cache hit rate increased for org-lookup endpoints.

maria: good. please keep rollback in place and maintain cached fallback for the next 1h while we monitor. start notifying SRE runbook owners and CS for customer impact.

anita: sending customer-facing note to CS: "Some API requests experienced elevated 5xx errors between 12:11–12:40 UTC. We applied a config rollback and enabled cached fallbacks; most requests recovered. We're monitoring and will follow up."

jay: adding a temporary circuit-breaker on controlplane->config-service to avoid cascade: set max_concurrency=10 and failure_threshold=0.2
```json
{"route":"/config/*","circuit_breaker":{"max_concurrency":10,"failure_threshold":0.2}}
```

maria: tom, can you confirm the routing rollback diff and we can ship a hotfix later with improved retries/backoff and metric alerts?

tom: routing rollback confirmed. I'll prepare a small hotfix PR with retries/backoff and a stricter dependency circuit. planning to ship after we stabilize and do a quick canary.

svc_incident_bot: RESOLVE: error rate returned below alert threshold at 2591240000. Incident status: mitigated — rollback + cached fallback + circuit-breaker applied.

maria: mitigation worked. customer impact: estimated requests impacted ~3% of traffic, sustained for ~30m, small set of enterprise customers saw transient failures. CS notified. Raising postmortem and follow-up actions: (1) tighten dependency SLOs and alerts, (2) add automated fallback wiring for org-lookup, (3) test cascade scenarios in chaos env, (4) review recent routing change rollout process.

anita: I'll coordinate postmortem scheduling and filing the incident ticket. assigning to @tom and @leo for root-cause.

jay: I'll capture dashboards and attach comparison snapshots. linking to telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/inci/2591234567

maria: thanks everyone. staying on watch for 30m. if anything new pops, reopen thread. :white_check_mark:
